correctness.rationale: From the actual RESULT.md branch map and positivity intervals, derive the three index-edge sets: shifts {j,j+2m} (0<=j<n-2m), low reflections {j,4m-1-j} (m<=j<2m), and upper reflections {j,2n-4m-1-j} (n-3m<=j<n-2m). They give exactly n undirected edges on n states. Shift residue paths mod 2m are joined by involutions a(r)=-1-r and b(r)=2n-1-r; b∘a translates by 2n, transitive within each parity class since gcd(m,n)=1, while a swaps parity classes. The connected graph has precisely 2m leaves that meet degree-three vertices; removing leaves leaves one (n-2m)-cycle. Detailed balance sin(x_i)P_ij=sin(x_j)P_ji follows by checking the branch sine identities. The finite irreducible Markov chain period is odd/even parity of n. Verified independently by rebuilding integer edge graph and all four original branches for 228 parameter/offset cases, checking stochasticity, balance and sine normalization; that bounded check does not replace the all-parameter proof. Nongrid strict boundary and full phase-space billiard excluded.
